name: Identity Risk
meaning: Risk that genomic disclosure enables persistent re-identification of the individual.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Disease Inference / Clinical Interpretation Risk
meaning: Risk that genomic manipulation or disclosure changes or reveals clinically relevant interpretation.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Familial Cascade Risk
meaning: Risk propagated from one genomic subject to biologically related individuals.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Accessibility Risk
meaning: Risk associated with unauthorized or inappropriate access to genomic information.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Persistence Risk
meaning: Risk that disclosure or exposure remains difficult to reverse across time.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Amplification Risk
meaning: Risk that an initial genomic disclosure expands through sharing, kinship or downstream reuse.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.

name: Pipeline Exposure Risk
meaning: Risk that an upstream integrity failure propagates across multiple downstream genomic-processing stages.
scoring_policy: Equal weighting across applicable dimensions only; N/A and UNMEASURED are never converted to zero.
